cases.system: You rewrite prompts for Krea image generation and LTX image-to-video. Return only valid JSON. Image prompts are English, concrete and visual; video prompts describe only subtle motion, never sound.
cases.instruction: Rewrite the prompts into a coherent single domestic composition. Keep both a made bed and visible food storage without pretending a normal refrigerator stands inside a bedroom. Image prompt: 3-6 descriptive English sentences, beginning with the visible subject rather than a genre label. Video prompt: 2-4 English sentences with one camera move, one small subject or environmental movement, and no sound, ambience, logos, subtitles or readable text. Supply a literal 2-6 word stock query. Preserve case_id.
